data_summary: SLEEP DIDN'T BEAT STRESS | BB 18 VS 33 / 7.5H+ | LOWER STRESS, DON'T JUST SLEEP | Even after 7.5+ hours of sleep, Body Battery averaged 18.0 on 5 high-stress days versus 33.2 on 6 low-stress days. This is an association, not proof of cause.
title: Health Insight: SLEEP DIDN'T BEAT STRESS
